register-domain.sh: a dry run. These are the calls --apply makes; nothing is sent.

whether the account holds omarchy-mac.org already
  POST https://api.porkbun.com/api/json/v3/domain/listAll {}
the price, and a rehearsal that charges nothing
  POST https://api.porkbun.com/api/json/v3/domain/checkDomain/omarchy-mac.org {}
  POST https://api.porkbun.com/api/json/v3/domain/create/omarchy-mac.org {"cost":0,"agreeToTerms":"yes","dryRun":true}
the purchase, with --apply --cost and only at that price
  POST https://api.porkbun.com/api/json/v3/domain/create/omarchy-mac.org {"cost":<--cost>,"agreeToTerms":"yes"}
